component.name: Lumen Presenter
component.summary: Show lyrics, scripture, media and slides in worship services

description.p: Lumen Presenter puts song lyrics, Bible passages, videos, pictures and slide decks on the screens of a church service. It is free for everyone, works without internet, and keeps the audience output running even if the operator window stops.

ul.li: A service plan, a song library with fast search, and imports from other programs
Every freely licensed Bible translation, bundled
Themes, timers, messages, lower thirds, a stage display and a stream output
A phone remote, MIDI and OSC control, and sharing plans on the local network
